description: This PHP source file defines the GuzzleHandler class, which is a request handler that sends PSR-7-compatible HTTP requests using Guzzle 6. It includes methods to invoke requests asynchronously and handle errors, as well as parsing options for transfer statistics.

classes.name: GuzzleHandler
classes.description: A request handler class that sends PSR-7 requests using Guzzle 6, supporting asynchronous requests and custom options parsing.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a provided or new Guzzle client.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles sending the request asynchronously and wraps error handling into a rejected promise.

methods.name: parseOptions
methods.description: Parses and modifies the request options, especially handling the 'http_stats_receiver' callback.
